metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2025 · 100 Meters
metas.description: Gifted runner Togashi dominates 100m races until transfer student Komiya arrives, motivating him to train harder. Years later, they compete as rivals on the racetrack.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2024 · Lubber Pandhu
metas.description: Set against the rural backdrop, explores gully cricket stars Gethu and Anbu's intense rivalry. Anbu's romantic involvement with Gethu's daughter escalates the clash. Their skills and emotions are put to the ultimate test.
